decision: Do not replace TMUX1101 on the strength of powered-off protection alone. Analog absolute rating no longer tracks VDD, but SETI voltage, leakage and intermediate-supply behavior remain unbounded for this circuit.
distinctions: VDD=0 powered-off leakage is not a leakage bound throughout 0<VDD<1.5 V.
Powered-off leakage must not be inserted into a powered USB startup calculation as if simultaneous; evaluate each operating state separately.
Absolute maximum ratings are stress limits, not functional guarantees.
Different package and pin count require fresh footprint, route and mechanical checks.
